name: bitwarden
description: Look up, create and organize items in your Bitwarden vault through Bitwarden's official MCP server. Works with bitwarden.com, the EU cloud and self-hosted servers. Hob logs in with your API key and unlocks the vault with your master password; items the assistant reads are sent to your model provider.

BW_SERVER.title: 服务器地址
BW_SERVER.description: 私有部署填你的地址，例如 https://vault.example.com；EU 云填 https://vault.bitwarden.eu；用 bitwarden.com 留空。

BW_CLIENTID.title: API 密钥 client_id
BW_CLIENTID.description: 网页版 设置 → 安全 → 密钥 → 查看 API 密钥。

BW_PASSWORD.title: 主密码
BW_PASSWORD.description: 用来解锁密码库，只交给本机的 Bitwarden 命令行。
